standard.label: Standard
standard.description: PCBWay's own KiCad design rules (their 2-layer, 1 oz set) as the starting point. "Use the fab's smallest values" switches to the capabilities page's minimums, which can cost more.

trackWidth.anchor: Minimum Trace Width and Spacing (outer layer)
trackWidth.quote: (rule "Minimum Trace Width and Spacing (outer layer)" (constraint track_width (min 0.127mm)) (constraint clearance (min 0.127mm)) (layer outer) (condition "A.Type == 'track'"))
trackWidth.note: The active 2-layer, 1 oz rule. Their inner-layer rule is 0.1 mm; PCBJam applies the outer value to every layer (a per-layer clearance rule would override the net classes).

minimum.quote: Min manufacturable trace is 4mil(0.1mm), Please view the below "Advanced PCB" or contact us if your board exceeds these.

clearance.anchor: Minimum Trace Width and Spacing (outer layer)
clearance.quote: (rule "Minimum Trace Width and Spacing (outer layer)" (constraint track_width (min 0.127mm)) (constraint clearance (min 0.127mm)) (layer outer) (condition "A.Type == 'track'"))
clearance.note: The active 2-layer, 1 oz rule; applied to every layer (see track width).

minimum.quote: Min manufacturable spacing is 4mil(0.1mm), Please view the below "Advanced PCB" or contact us if your board exceeds these.

viaDrill.anchor: Minimum Via Diameter and Hole Size
viaDrill.quote: (rule "Minimum Via Diameter and Hole Size" (constraint hole_size (min 0.3mm)) (constraint via_diameter (min 0.5mm)) (condition "A.Type == 'via'"))

minimum.quote: Min drill size is 0.15mm, max drill is 6.0mm. Any holes greater than 6mm or smaller than 0.2mm will be subject to extra charges.

viaDiameter.anchor: Minimum Via Diameter and Hole Size
viaDiameter.quote: (rule "Minimum Via Diameter and Hole Size" (constraint hole_size (min 0.3mm)) (constraint via_diameter (min 0.5mm)) (condition "A.Type == 'via'"))

minimum.quote: For pads with vias in the middle, Min width for Annular Ring is 0.15mm(6mil).

holeMin.note: The smallest hole any of the file's hole rules allows (vias 0.3, plated holes 0.2, non-plated 0.5).

minimum.quote: Min drill size is 0.15mm, max drill is 6.0mm. Any holes greater than 6mm or smaller than 0.2mm will be subject to extra charges.

castellatedHoleMin.quote: (rule "Minimum Castellated Hole Size" (constraint hole_size (min 0.6mm)) (condition "A.Type == 'pad' && A.Fabrication_Property == 'Castellated pad'"))

minimum.note: Advanced PCB table, Normal process column.

platedSlotMin.quote: (rule "Min. Plated Slot Width" (constraint hole_size (min 0.5mm)) (condition "(A.Hole_Size_X != A.Hole_Size_Y) && A.isPlated()"))

holeToHole.quote: (rule "via to via clearance (same nets)" (constraint hole_to_hole (min 0.254mm)) (condition "A.Type == 'via' && B.Type == A.Type && A.Net == B.Net"))
holeToHole.note: Board-wide hole-to-hole floor; holes on different nets get 0.5 mm (next rule).

holeToHoleOtherNet.quote: (rule "hole to hole clearance (different nets)" (constraint hole_to_hole (min 0.5mm)) (condition "A.Net != B.Net"))

minimum.note: 16 mil = 0.406 mm, the component hole row of the Advanced PCB table, Normal process column.

holeClearance.quote: (rule "NPTH with copper around" (constraint hole_clearance (min 0.20mm)) (condition "A.Pad_Type == 'NPTH, mechanical' && B.Type != 'track'"))
holeClearance.note: Board-wide hole-to-copper floor; the file's other hole clearances are larger.

npthToTrack.quote: (rule "NPTH to Track clearance" (constraint hole_clearance (min 0.254mm)) (condition "A.Pad_Type == 'NPTH, mechanical' && B.Type == 'track'"))

pthToTrack.quote: (rule "PTH to Track clearance" (constraint hole_clearance (min 0.33mm)) (condition "A.isPlated() && A.Type != 'Via' && B.Type == 'track'"))

padToTrack.quote: (rule "Pad to Track clearance" (constraint clearance (min 0.2mm)) (condition "A.isPlated() && A.Type != 'Via' && B.Type == 'track'"))
padToTrack.note: Applied to the Default net class only, so a wider class keeps its own clearance.

copperEdge.note: PCBJam applies it to all copper, not only tracks.

minimum.note: CNC milling, Medium difficulty column of the Advanced PCB table.

trackWidth.anchor: The min width/spacing of outer layer (before compensation)
trackWidth.note: 7 mil width, 70 µm (2 oz) copper, Normal process column.

minimum.anchor: Minimum Trace Width and Spacing (outer layer)
minimum.quote: (rule "Minimum Trace Width and Spacing (outer layer)" (constraint track_width (min 0.1524mm)) (constraint clearance (min 0.1778mm)) (layer outer) (condition "A.Type == 'track'"))

clearance.anchor: The min width/spacing of outer layer (before compensation)
clearance.note: 8 mil spacing, 70 µm (2 oz) copper, Normal process column.

minimum.anchor: Minimum Trace Width and Spacing (outer layer)
minimum.quote: (rule "Minimum Trace Width and Spacing (outer layer)" (constraint track_width (min 0.1524mm)) (constraint clearance (min 0.1778mm)) (layer outer) (condition "A.Type == 'track'"))

pthAnnular.note: Component hole, 70 µm (2 oz) copper, Normal process column.
